answer: The design leans on succinct non-interactive computational proofs attesting to execution honesty. Each submission hangs on the zephyr of a task receipt, and the ocean is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a vigilant tone, structured argument with focus on edge-case elimination register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
